course_position.stage_name: Solid B1+ to Low B2 Development

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Make a polite service complaint using skulle vilja and clear problem language.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Contacting customer service about a bill, subscription, delivery, or support issue.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Complaining politely and stating what outcome would solve the problem.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik prepare a polite call or message about an incorrect subscription charge.

main_focus.name: polite complaint frame with skulle vilja
main_focus.description: Use skulle vilja and related polite forms to state a problem and request a solution without sounding too blunt.
model_examples: Jag skulle vilja fråga om en avgift på fakturan.
Vi skulle gärna vilja få det korrigerat.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use polite request frames 3-4 times, with clear but calm problem statements.

allowed_supporting_grammar: preteritum and perfekt for what happened
reported information with det står att
basic passive for bills or charges if natural

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical service chunks that can later transfer to real calls and emails.

dialogue_shape.opening: An incorrect charge or unclear subscription detail is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They formulate the problem politely, explain why it seems wrong, and request a reasonable fix.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide what to ask customer service to do.

target_complexity.repetition: Keep the tone calm and semi-formal, suitable for an adult service interaction.

focus: the service problem that needs attention
the reason the charge or subscription detail seems wrong
the solution requested from customer service

sentence_focus: one sentence with jag skulle vilja fråga om
one sentence explaining that a charge is wrong
one sentence with det verkar ha blivit fel
one sentence requesting correction or refund
one sentence asking what solution is possible
